007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.DeserializationFeature;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
016import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
017import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
018import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolInput;
019import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolParams;
020import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolStatus;
021import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolType;
022
023import java.util.List;
024import java.util.Map;
025
026/**
027 * Sample for creating a DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT tool.
028 *
029 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_PARAMS_JSON} to a JSON object when the
030 * selected built-in tool requires parameters. For example, a SQL tool needs
031 * {@code {"profile_name":"MY_PROFILE"}}. The SDK maps the supplied object to
032 * a typed {@link ToolParams} model. For builder-based configuration without
033 * JSON, see {@link ToolParamsSample}. Database-backed typed creation examples
034 * are {@link CreateSqlToolSample}, {@link CreateRagToolSample},
035 * {@link CreateWebSearchToolSample},
036 * {@link CreateSlackNotificationToolSample}, and
037 * {@link CreateEmailNotificationToolSample}.</p>
038 *
039 * <p>For a tool with input metadata, set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_NAME}
040 * and optionally {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_DESCRIPTION}. This adds one
041 * typed {@link ToolInput}; the database validates it against the configured
042 * tool. See {@link ToolInputSample} for an offline example and
043 * {@link CreateToolWithInputsSample} for a focused custom-function example. Creation persists
044 * the tool until it is dropped; use {@link DropToolSample} with the same tool
045 * name and connection settings for cleanup.</p>
046 */
047public final class CreateToolSample {
048
049    private CreateToolSample() {
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
054     *
055     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
056     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
057     */
058    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
059        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
060        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createSelectAIAgent()) {
061            ToolAttributes.Builder builder = ToolAttributes.builder()
062                    .instruction(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION"))
063                    .function(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_FUNCTION"));
064            String toolType = env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_TYPE");
065            if (toolType != null) {
066                builder.toolTypeValue(toolType);
067            }
068            String toolParamsJson = env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_PARAMS_JSON");
069            if (toolParamsJson != null) {
070                builder.toolParams(parseToolParams(toolType, toolParamsJson));
071            }
072            String inputName = env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_NAME");
073            if (inputName != null) {
074                builder.toolInputs(List.of(ToolInput.builder()
075                        .name(inputName)
076                        .description(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_DESCRIPTION"))
077                        .build()));
078            }
079            Tool tool = selectAIAgent.tool(toolName, builder.build(),
080                    env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION"), status("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_STATUS"));
081
082            boolean created = tool.create();
083            System.out.printf("Create tool '%s' completed: %s%n", tool.getToolName(), created);
084        }
085    }
086
087    private static SelectAIAgent createSelectAIAgent() throws SelectAIException {
088        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
089                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
090                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
091                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
092                .build());
093    }
094
095    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
096        String value = System.getenv(name);
097        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
098            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
099        }
100        return value;
101    }
102
103    private static String env(String name) {
104        String value = System.getenv(name);
105        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
106    }
107
108    private static ToolParams parseToolParams(String toolType, String json) {
109        try {
110            Map<String, Object> values = new ObjectMapper()
111                    .enable(DeserializationFeature.USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS)
112                    .readValue(json, new TypeReference<Map<String, Object>>() { });
113            if (values == null) {
114                throw new IllegalArgumentException("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_PARAMS_JSON must be a JSON object");
115            }
116            return ToolParams.fromMap(toolType == null ? null : ToolType.of(toolType), values);
117        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
118            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_PARAMS_JSON must be a valid JSON object", e);
119        }
120    }
121
122    private static ToolStatus status(String name) {
123        String value = env(name);
124        return value == null ? null : ToolStatus.fromValue(value);
125    }
126}
